messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — ACME reports their contract promo didn't apply to PO 78910. Invoice INV-2026-334 shows full charge. They included PO note 'Apply Q2-ENT-50' per contract C-4242. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/acme/inv-334.png

Evan (Enterprise Sales): Thanks Maya. I did add promo Q2-ENT-50 on 2025-11-05 against contract C-4242. Can you confirm invoice id and any error logs?

Maya (CS): Invoice is INV-2026-334, txn 8f7a33. Customer says our API returned 200 for the invoice create but promo never attached. Server log: https://files.redwood/logs/INV-2026-334.log

Priya (Finance): Can you run the reconcile with promos and paste the payload? Run: `billing-cli get-invoice --id INV-2026-334 --include-promos --format json`

BillingBot: `{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-334","promo_id":null,"error":"promo_mapping_missing","details":"missing contract_id in invoice metadata"}`

Maya (CS): We have an earlier API trace showing `403 promo_not_authorized` at 2026-03-15T13:02:11Z for external_id=ACME-22, but the flow continued to create the invoice without failing which left promo_id null.

Evan (Enterprise Sales): Got it. We can issue a one-time manual credit equal to the promo (USD 5,000). Need finance sign-off and GL code. Priya?

Priya (Finance): Approve for manual credit. Please include PO# and sales approver in the note. Use GL code 4302-credits. I'll apply and create a finance ticket.

Maya (CS): PO note text for records: "Apply Q2-ENT-50 per contract C-4242 — PO 78910"

Evan (Enterprise Sales): Approving now. Finance will run this snippet:
```python
finance.adjust_credit(invoice='INV-2026-334', amount=5000, note='Manual promo grant PO 78910 - Evan')
```

Priya (Finance): Credit applied and ticket created: FIN-2026-0456. Reconciliation now shows promo_id: Q2-ENT-50 attached to the invoice. It may take up to 24h to reflect in the customer portal.

Maya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and confirm once portal shows it. Also, can eng-billing add a guard so PO-note mapping requires contract_id in invoice metadata to avoid silent misses? @Jordan (eng-billing)

Jordan (eng-billing): On it — filing ENG-B-987 to add strict validation and a reconciliation alert if promo_id is null but PO note/promo exists. I will follow up with a PR and ETA.

Maya (CS): Thanks all — customer updated and happy. Closing thread.
